headline: US Stock Futures Rise Ahead of Key Earnings Reports and Elections
summary: U.S. stock futures edged higher following a challenging October, as investors turned their attention to upcoming corporate earnings and election developments.
why: U.S. stock index futures signal broad investor sentiment and market direction across global financial markets ahead of critical economic events.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: US stock futures edged higher as investors focused on corporate earnings and upcoming elections.

why_moved: U.S. futures moved higher as equity markets recovered slightly from October losses while awaiting earnings and election clarity.
